text:
Jasmin: quick heads-up — running a sweep on KB and saw two pages returning 200 but with include failures (image 403 + missing frontmatter owner). putting notes here so we can triage.

Jasmin: /kb/runtime-ops/kv-cache.md — image at s3://kb-images/runtime/kv-diagram.png -> 403 when loaded via CDN. Also frontmatter missing owner field, shows `owner:` empty.

Jasmin: /kb/setup/airgap-install.md — MDX include referencing /snippets/docker/runtime.json which 404s. frontmatter has `custodian: ''` not set.

Marta: thanks — can you open a tiny PR with frontmatter add + placeholder image so customers don't see broken embeds? I can follow-up to find the real image.

Jasmin: yep created branch and tiny PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4567 — adds `owner: team:docs` and swaps in placeholder svg.

Ryan: I'll take the airgap include. pinging @eng-runtime for the snippet that got moved last week.

eng-runtime-bot: @channel snippet-migration: runtime snippets moved to s3://kb-snippets/2026/ — see migration log: https://internal.kb/migrations/2026

Ryan: ok found it, opened PR to update include path: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4568 — small path fix.

Marta: nit — prefer `owners: team:docs` plural field (we standardized on 'owners' last quarter). Can you update PR 4567?

Jasmin: updated PR 4567 to use `owners: [team:docs]`. thanks.

Marta: LGTM. @ryan can you merge after CI passes? :thumbsup: 

Ryan: merging now — CI green. Merged and deployed to staging.

Jasmin: thanks all. I'll keep an eye on monitoring for 24h and file follow-up ticket if any 403s recur: INT-1234.

Marta: perfect — I'll mark the KB entries as stable in the docs tracker.
